title: The Matrix
note: Subject v2.0. construct.py runs twice: with the Python outside any virtual environment, then inside a fresh `python3 -m venv matrix_env` (activated like `source matrix_env/bin/activate`): outside it must give the venv commands, inside show the venv and its site-packages, and the two outputs must differ. loading.py runs with pandas / numpy / matplotlib made unimportable (no crash, missing packages named, pip and Poetry instructions), then, when they are installed in the Python running the tests (never installed by the tester: SKIP otherwise), it must create an image, show the versions and pip vs Poetry; requirements.txt and pyproject.toml are parsed. oracle.py (needs python-dotenv) runs without configuration, with a .env, with development / production and with environment overrides; .env.example and .gitignore are read. Example lines are warnings only. Source: the subject's modules (typing: warning), type hints, flake8, mypy (loading.py: import errors are a warning, the subject allows them).
